criteria_results.text: Each Tool and Chat screen has one compact title/navigation header rather than stacked large-title/breadcrumb headers.
criteria_results.notes: The physical iPhone still showed a large Chats row with project, terminal, and add buttons plus separate project and lifecycle filter rows. AJ asked for every control except search to move into the top-right overflow menu.

criteria_results.text: Agents supports all/project-filtered active, completed, and archived chats with create, open, rename, archive, restore, fork, and confirmed delete actions plus nested child sessions.
criteria_results.notes: Only sessions created from mobile appeared as Chats. Existing desktop-created human sessions appeared in Activity instead, while scheduled-task and background-loop sessions were visible in their dedicated categories.

criteria_results.text: Review Queue exposes proposal details and approve/reject actions with high-risk approval confirmation, while Report Card renders run-quality summaries.
criteria_results.notes: The physical iPhone Review Queue showed the empty-state text 'Nothing here yet' despite desktop data being expected.

criteria_results.text: Email and Gallery remain usable through production Rhythm Cloud while the paired Mac is offline, use least-privilege summaries, and never cache full email bodies or OAuth data.
criteria_results.notes: Gallery showed 'Nothing here yet' on the physical iPhone even though content was visible on desktop.

criteria_results.text: The Agents and Tools surfaces run on a physical iPhone without React rendering errors or invalid icon warnings.
criteria_results.notes: Metro repeatedly reported that Dialog.Actions passed compact to React.Fragment in session-configuration-sheet.tsx, plus invalid MaterialCommunityIcons names for settings-suggest, a stethoscope emoji, and assets/agents/opencode.png.

criteria_results.text: Large Skills, MCP Servers, Agent Profiles, and Providers & Models catalogs provide usable search, organization, and sorting controls.
criteria_results.notes: AJ reported that the long catalog screens lack organization, search, and sorting and that Providers & Models lists unfamiliar entries without explaining what the surface represents.

failure_output: AJ: only sessions I create in mobile show up as chats, and the rest show up in activity; Review Queue and Gallery show 'Nothing here yet'. Metro: Invalid prop compact supplied to React.Fragment; invalid MaterialCommunityIcons names settings-suggest, stethoscope emoji, and assets/agents/opencode.png.
suggested_follow_up: Add physical-device/live-data contracts for Agents header density, desktop-human session classification, Review Queue/Gallery parity, console cleanliness, and catalog findability instead of relying on source-shape and fake-server checks.
